Fresh sourdough, delivered weekly

Crust & Crumb is a two-person bakery working out of a converted garage on the north side of town. Every loaf is mixed by hand on Wednesday, cold-proofed overnight, and baked on Thursday evening so it reaches your door on Friday morning while the crust is still crackling. We mill a portion of our own flour from regional wheat, keep the ingredient list to flour, water, salt and starter, and never use dough conditioners or commercial yeast.

How the subscription works

Choose a loaf, pick a delivery day, and change or pause your order at any time from your account page. There is no contract and no minimum term. Deliveries inside the ring road are free; anything further out is charged at cost.

What is in the box

  • One 900 g country sourdough loaf
  • A rotating seasonal bake, such as rye with caraway or olive and rosemary
  • A short note about the flour we used that week
